

# Dada2
```{r}
# 1. Install BiocManager if you do not have it yet
if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")

# 2. Install the dada2 package
BiocManager::install("dada2")

# 3. Load the library into your R session
library("dada2")
```


```{r}
library("dada2")
```


```{r}
path <- "../Files/"
list.files(path)
```



```{r}
fnFs <- sort(list.files(path, pattern = ".R1.fastq", full.names=T))
fnRs <- sort(list.files(path, pattern = ".R2.fastq", full.names=T))

sample.names <- sapply(strsplit(basename(fnFs), "_"), `[`, 1)
```


```{r}
plotQualityProfile(fnFs[1:4])
plotQualityProfile(fnRs[1:4])
```


```{r}
filtFs <- file.path(path, "filtered", paste0(sample.names, "_F_filt.fastq.gz"))
filtRs <- file.path(path, "filtered", paste0(sample.names, "_R_filt.fastq.gz"))

names(filtFs) <- sample.names
names(filtRs) <- sample.names
```


```{r}
out <- filterAndTrim(fnFs, filtFs, fnRs, filtRs, truncLen = c(132, 130), truncQ = 2, rm.phix = T,
                     maxN = 0, maxEE = c(0.5,0.5), compress = T, multithread = T)
```

```{r}
head(out)
```
```{r}
plotQualityProfile(filtFs[1:10])
plotQualityProfile(filtRs[1:10])
```

```{r}
errF <- learnErrors(filtFs, multithread = T)
errR <- learnErrors(filtRs, multithread = T)

plotErrors(errF, nominalQ = T)
plotErrors(errR, nominalQ = T)

```


```{r}
dadaFs <- dada(filtFs, errF, multithread = T)
dadaRs <- dada(filtRs, errR, multithread = T)
```


```{r}
mergers <- mergePairs(dadaFs, filtFs, dadaRs, filtRs, verbose=T, minOverlap = 9)
?mergePairs
```


```{r}
seqtab <- makeSequenceTable(mergers)
dim(seqtab)
table(nchar(getSequences(seqtab)))
```

```{r}
seqtab.nochim <- removeBimeraDenovo(seqtab, method="consensus", multithread=T, verbose=T)
?removeBimeraDenovo
```

```{r}
dim(seqtab.nochim)
table(nchar(getSequences(seqtab.nochim)))
```

```{r}
getN <- function(x) sum(getUniques(x))
track <- cbind(out, sapply(dadaFs, getN), sapply(dadaRs, getN), sapply(mergers, getN), rowSums(seqtab.nochim))
# If processing a single sample, remove the sapply calls: e.g. replace sapply(dadaFs, getN) with getN(dadaFs)
colnames(track) <- c("input", "filtered", "denoisedF", "denoisedR", "merged", "nonchim")
rownames(track) <- sample.names
head(track)
```


```{r}
taxa <- assignTaxonomy(seqtab.nochim, "../Database/silva_nr99_v138.1_train_set.fa.gz", multithread = T)
taxa.print <- taxa
rownames(taxa.print) <- NULL 
taxa.print <- data.frame(taxa.print)
```

# Phyloseq

```{r}
library("phyloseq")
```
```{r}
otu <- data.frame(seqtab.nochim)
colnames(otu) <- paste0("sp",1:ncol(otu))
otu_tab <- otu_table(otu, taxa_are_rows = F)
```

```{r}
tax <- data.frame(taxa)
rownames(tax) <- paste0("sp",1:nrow(tax))
tax_tab <- tax_table(tax)
```

```{r}
sam_dat <- read.csv("metadata_seminar01.csv")
rownames(sam_dat) <- sam_dat$bee_file
sam_da <- sample_data(sam_dat)
```

```{r}
phy_bee <- phyloseq(tax_tab,otu_tab,sam_da)
```


```{r}
saveRDS(phy_bee, "phy_bee.RDS")
phy_sem2 <- readRDS("phy_bee.RDS")
```



# Preliminary analysis

```{r}
install.packages("pheatmap")

library(microbiome)
library(pheatmap)
```

```{r}
colnames(phy_sem2@tax_table)
head(phy_sem2@tax_table)
kingdom <- tax_glom(phy_bee, "ta1")
phylum <- tax_glom(phy_bee, "ta2")
genus <- tax_glom(phy_bee, "ta6")
```

```{r}
taxa1 <- core_members(genus, detection=10,prevalence = 0.05)
fin.phy <- prune_taxa(taxa1,genus)
```


```{r}
dat <- data.frame(fin.phy@otu_table)
colnames(dat) <- fin.phy@tax_table[,6]
```


```{r}
install.packages('reshape')
library(reshape)
library(ggplot2)

dat$names <- rownames(dat)
long_dat <- reshape::melt(dat)
```

```{r}
plot <- long_dat %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=value, y=names)) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill=variable), stat="identity", position="fill")
```

```{r}
pheatmap(data.frame(t(select(dat,-names))),
         border_color = F,
         cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = F)
```

```{r}
genus_clr <- microbiome::transform(fin.phy, "clr")
genus_clr_dataframe <- data.frame(genus_clr@otu_table)
genus_clr_dataframe <- data.frame(t(genus_clr_dataframe))
rownames(genus_clr_dataframe) <- genus_clr@tax_table[,6]

pheatmap(genus_clr_dataframe,
         border_color = F,
         cluster_rows = F, cluster_cols = F)
```


```{r}
install.packages("vegan")
library(vegan)
```

```{r}
simp <- vegan::diversity(genus@otu_table, index="simpson")
shan <- vegan::diversity(genus@otu_table, index = "shannon")
obs <- rowSums(genus@otu_table!=0)
alph <- data.frame(simp, shan, obs, genus@sam_data)
alpha_long <- reshape::melt(alph)
```


```{r}
ggplot(alpha_long, aes(x=Place.whole, y=value, fill=Place.whole)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.5) +
  facet_wrap(. ~ variable, scales="free", ncol=1, strip.position="right")
```

```{r}
simp <- vegan::diversity(fin.phy@otu_table, index="simpson")
shan <- vegan::diversity(fin.phy@otu_table, index = "shannon")
obs <- rowSums(fin.phy@otu_table!=0)
alph <- data.frame(simp, shan, obs, fin.phy@sam_data)
alpha_long <- reshape::melt(alph)

ggplot(alpha_long, aes(x=Place.whole, y=value, fill=Place.whole)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha=0.5) +
  facet_wrap(. ~ variable, scales="free", ncol=1, strip.position="right")
```
